name: Alex Silva
headline: Senior Backend Engineer | TypeScript | AWS Cloud Architecture | Event-Driven Systems
summary: Backend Engineer with 6+ years in distributed systems and cloud architecture, specialized in TypeScript, Node.js and AWS. Cut API response times by 65% for a platform serving 2M+ daily requests. Reduced deployment time by 40% by redesigning CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions. Seeking a Senior Backend Engineer role in global remote teams, solving scalability and reliability challenges.

achievements.title: API performance
achievements.text: Enhanced API performance achieving 65% faster response times through query optimization and Redis caching, serving 2M+ daily requests.

achievements.title: Scheduling at scale
achievements.text: Built an event-driven scheduling system handling 100k+ events/day with AWS EventBridge and Lambda, reducing operational costs by $12K/year.

achievements.title: CI/CD speed
achievements.text: Optimized CI/CD pipelines reducing deployment time by 40% (25 to 15 min) via Docker layer caching and parallel tests.

experience.context: Largest virtual delivery support company in Brazil
bullets: Developed Node.js microservices in TypeScript achieving 99.8% uptime for 500K+ daily active users.
Architected an event-driven scheduler on AWS EventBridge and Lambda, processing 100k+ daily events and cutting manual intervention by 85%.
Streamlined CI/CD with GitHub Actions and Docker caching, reducing deployment time from 25 to 15 minutes.
Implemented monitoring with Grafana and Sentry, reducing mean time to recovery by ~60%.

experience.context: One of Brazil's largest customer-experience platforms
bullets: Resolved latency issues in the main API by optimizing a critical database query, reducing response time by 65%.
Modernized the backend with NestJS and TypeORM, enabling modular APIs shared across 4 product teams.
Shipped releases through CI/CD pipelines on GCP, achieving a 40% reduction in deployment time.
Led DevOps initiatives that optimized CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins and AWS CodePipeline, improving release stability for 5 client projects.
Engineered microservices with API Gateway, Lambda and SQS, delivering 3 PoCs that shortened client time-to-market.
Scaled infrastructure with CloudFormation and ECS/Fargate, cutting environment setup from days to under 1 hour.
